description: Donnée Ouverte sur les Routes et Trottoirs du Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Transports. Cette base de données est conçue pour analyser les caractéristiques des trottoirs associés aux routes, telles que les matériaux, la qualité et la largeur. Ces informations sont utiles pour évaluer les infrastructures urbaines et planifier les travaux d'entretien ou d'amélioration. Lien vers la source: Cliquez ici. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Transports. Its tags are route, territoire. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
